spans.s: SEEING THAT: = since, for, because: q. v.

SEIGNEURIAL, SEIGNIORIAL: expr. by gen. or
comp.

SEIZE:
I To catch: q. v.: गृह्नाति (ग्रह्, c.
9.),
to s. me:
ग्रहणे मम, Mah. vii. 73. 1.;
s. s by the hair:
केशैर्गृह्नाति, P.
II To take
possession of: गृह्नाति,
your house has been s. d
by another alligator:
त्वदीयं गृहमपरेण मकरेण गृहीतम्,
P. iv. 9.: v. Also to enter.
III To in-
-vade, attack: q. v.: आक्रामति (क्रम्, c. 1.):
v. Also to possess.
IV To apprehend:
गृह्नाति, प्र-,
to s. on suspicion:
शङ्कया गृह्णाति, Y.:
v. To arrest.

SEIZER:
(1) ग्राहक (f. हिका), Y.;
(2) ग्रहीतृ
(f. त्री).
